title: The poet Virgil dies at Brundisium
summary: Virgil, author of the Aeneid, died at Brundisium after falling ill on a journey back from Greece. He had asked for the unfinished epic to be burned, but Augustus had it published.
reason: Virgil had spent his last decade writing the Aeneid, a national epic for Augustan Rome, and fell ill while travelling.
significance: The Aeneid survived and became the central work of Latin literature.
